newsitem.title: UK: LME zinc stays firm in evening trade.
newsitem.headline: LME zinc stays firm in evening trade.

text.p: Zinc stayed firm in late London Metal Exchange trade on Friday, after surging higher in afternoon trade on waves of speculative buying.
By 1800 GMT the metal was indicated at $1,627/$1,630, compared with a kerb close of $1,624.
Its rally has been fuelled by a battle between short Chinese smelters and long speculators.

Zinc took aluminium and copper up with it during the afternoon. However, aluminium eased slightly in evening trade. By 1800 GMT aluminium was shown at $1,680/$1,683, compared with a kerb close of $1,685. Copper stayed strong. It was indicated at $2,382/$2,387, compared with a kerb close of $2,374.
